text_block_list.name: Louise Marie
text_block_list.text:
This is the master of this cave...!
...But its appearance is different from the usual ones listed in the monster encyclopedia.
Overall, it's kind of black...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こいつがこの洞窟の主……！
……
でも
魔物辞典に載ってる通常種とは見た目が違う。
なんか全体的に、
黒い……！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text:
It's not just the appearance, Rui-chan!
It's probably much stronger than the usual ones...!
...Everyone, let's do our best...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
見た目だけじゃないよルイちゃん！
恐らく強さも
通常とは比べ物にならない……！
……みんな、
頑張ろう……！

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text:
It's alright, Nozomi-chan.
Our bodyguard is top-notch with swordsmanship.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫だよ
ノゾミちゃん。
うちの用心棒、
剣術は一流だからさ。

text_block_list.name: Iroha
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーい！
イロハはサイキョーでーす！

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.orig_text:
え……
魔物の動きが止まった！？

text_block_list.name: Sono
text_block_list.text: Like a frog being stared at by a snake, it's a snake being stared at by Iroha? But don't let your guard down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヘビに睨まれたカエルよろしく、
イロハに睨まれたヘビ
ってやつ？
でも
油断はしちゃ駄目だからね。
